__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Existing Prometheus datasource
__inputs.description: Select the existing Prometheus datasource that scrapes the CWO exporter.

description: Codex sessions using CWO: agents, recorded tokens, turn outcomes and turn time. Optional CWO audit logs add workflow activity; custom review files add external contractor reviews.

panels.title: Session scan
panels.description: Profile-wide collection: age of the last CWO session scan and whether available files were fully read. Partial means files are pending or records could not be read; check the collector's pending files and errors. Project and Session filters leave these values unchanged. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: time() - min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_timestamp_seconds[2m]))
min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m]))

panels.title: Workflow scans
panels.description: Profile-wide collection: age and completeness of configured audit logs and custom review files. Complete means those files were fully read; use the age to check freshness. If Partial persists, check the source paths, permissions and collector errors. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: time() - min(last_over_time({__name__=~"cwo_audit_scan_timestamp_seconds|cwo_review_scan_timestamp_seconds"}[2m]))
min(last_over_time({__name__=~"cwo_audit_collection_complete|cwo_review_collection_complete"}[2m]))

panels.title: Review collection
panels.description: Profile-wide external review collection. Gaps count unreadable, unsupported or incomplete launch records; a failed execution without a final usage record is an explained gap. The table retains known launch metadata. Check --once cwo_reviews.discovery for reasons and repair or restore the source; the collector retries on subsequent scans.

targets.expr: sum(cwo_review_discovery_gaps) + max(cwo_review_source_errors) + max(cwo_review_limit_reached)

panels.title: Recorded session tokens
panels.description: Whole-session recorded token totals for the selected CWO-associated sessions and agents. Includes earlier session history; this is not CWO-exclusive cost. Missing or conflicting usage is omitted, so the total can be a lower bound. Token scale: K = thousand; Mil = million; Bil = billion; Tri = trillion. Tables show exact counts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: CWO-associated session activity
panels.description: Sessions and subagents using CWO, active in the selected range. Tokens and turn counts cover their recorded session history. Turn counts separate completed turns from failed or aborted turns. Turn time sums reported turn durations, excluding time between turns. Last seen measures age at the selected range end. Model / effort shows the latest selected settings. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: External contractor reviews
panels.description: External review invocations selected by original launch time. Execution means the CLI completed or failed; Evaluation is the recorded evaluator verdict, separate from implementation success. Pending peer review stays explicit. Saved record describes missing evidence; missing token counts remain blank. Historical ranges include later-collected evidence within the 30-day retained review inventory. Project and Session filter the linked source session. [Custom Review Adapter](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/integrations/custom-review-adapter/). Historical samples survive normal export expiry; records withdrawn before expiry remain excluded.
